prompt: A big, airy, open-plan kitchen and living room, L-shaped, seen from a high bird's-eye view looking down at about 55 degrees like the Animal Crossing room camera: no ceiling, no front wall, walls only along the back and the two far sides, and the floor filling most of the frame as a wide open space to walk.
